name: B47ANCE'd Harvest

features.text: Bounded crop-provider inspection, field summaries excluding empty furrows, irrigation demand and legacy/branded API aliases.
Server/SP crop-side irrigation with explicit partial/unknown effect receipts; no atomic water-source transaction or automatic retry.
Live vanilla seasonal/seed guidance with native sandbox checks, calendar bounds and explicit custom planting windows.
Console crop inspection and save/reload-aware calendar diagnostics; native synchronization still requires runtime tests.
Player-facing field UI, soil/equipment systems and automated irrigation are not implemented.
Stable release requires dedicated MP evidence; Workshop test distribution does not satisfy G7.

limits: Offline Lua 5.4/5.1 fixtures and source checks only. SP/dedicated NOT TESTED. G7 and stable G8 BLOCKED. No hard dependency; seasonal calendar advice needs optional weatherWorks/map context.

relations.text: Consumes weatherWorks calendar observations when available; absent or incompatible context disables advice.
Waterworks retains source withdrawal/quality; atomic delivery and crop-effect coupling are not implemented.
